title: A term held only by an invoice shows 0 and 0 but is still in use
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop's own term was used on an invoice, and that customer has since been moved to another term.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, is held by no customer and no vendor today, but one invoice, {Invoice-A}, was created with it (its customer was later moved to another term).
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-26 Fourteen and {Invoice-A} is the invoice of work order S2-15440.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the {Term-A} row's Customers and Vendors cells.
  2. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  3. Hover "Edit".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: both read 0.
  • Step 2: the menu shows "Edit" and "Delete Credit Term" greyed out.
  • Step 3: the hover reads "Used by 1 invoice" with "Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." below it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S1-E2: “A term held only by invoices (no customer or vendor on it today) shows 0 in both columns but still counts as in use for Story 2: Row menu actions's locks.”
  • Terminology: “In use → A term is in use when at least one customer, vendor or invoice (work order or part sale invoice) holds it. Vendor invoices, deliveries and vendor credits store no term, so they never count. The Counter Sale customer is never counted. A customer or vendor with a blank term counts as COD. Every invoice ever created counts, including reversed and paid ones; estimates never count. Customers and vendors count and are listed whatever their status.”
  • S2-R2: “"{holders}" names only the holder types the term has, each with its count, singular or plural: for example "Used by 1 customer and 2 vendors", "Used by 12 customers, 3 vendors and 40 invoices", "Used by 5 invoices".”
